integrity: Numerical simulations and quadratures are corroborative; the mathematical limit is established analytically. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The compact-lambda moving-boundary regime has a proven two-term expansion but no claimed all-scale uniformity or extension to protruding disks. The classic arcsine chord law is prior art; originality is assigned to the explicit boundary crossover and conditional total-variation marks. The historical-priority search is incomplete, and the 1966 primary chord-distance article was not available in full.
title: A sharp moving-boundary target law for endpoint-uniform circular chords
